_comment: Hour-trace sibling of mix_dyn60_shift_m2Am1B_b1045_t75.json for the policies that read slo.<class>.tbt_ms LITERALLY as the per-token target -- PolyServe, llm-d, Llumnix SLO and the vLLM router -- because none of them can express an end-to-end budget. The agent class's promise is the same in both files, TTFT 7 s + 75 ms per token (FluidServe v0.4 section 1.3); they differ only in how the second half of it is delivered. FluidServe receives 75 through --fluidserve-class-budgets 25:decode:75 and keeps tbt_ms 25 as the TIER KEY its profile lookup and every log line name the class by, so its file must NOT say 75. Giving these policies that file instead would judge the agent class three times tighter than it is promised, which is the defect polyserve-fidelity.md section 9.5 is about. Scoring for both is FS_SWE_TBT_MS=75.
